name: CS Token stale sellAmount pair burn
summary: CS stores the current sell size in a global sellAmount variable, then lets a later qualifying transfer consume that stale value to burn 80% of it directly from the CS/USDT pair before calling pair.sync(). The attacker repeatedly paired a sale with a self-transfer to contract the CS reserve and drain USDT.
notes: Plain CS deployment; its 21,408-byte runtime is unchanged from creation through the exploit.

The exploit receipt's 515 USDT Transfer logs net to exactly 954,285.001826338883421706 USDT leaving the CS/USDT pair. The flash pair supplied 80,000,000 USDT principal and received 80,240,000 USDT, so the attacker EOA retained exactly 714,285.001826338883421706 USDT after the 240,000 USDT flash fee. Gross victim assets lost, rather than attacker net proceeds, is the comparable loss measure.
